figures.finding: The Netherlands Film Production Incentive, run by the Netherlands Film Fund, pays 35% of approved qualifying production costs spent in the Netherlands (plus up to 10% more for overruns), counting at most 80% of total costs, for features and animation costing at least EUR 1 million (documentaries EUR 250,000) with at least EUR 150,000 spent in the country and a cinema release; one company may receive at most EUR 3 million a year, total state aid may not pass 50% of costs (60% for multi-country co-productions), and the minister earmarks EUR 20 million a year.

notQualifying: producer's fee above 7.5% of qualifying production costs
value.regulation: Reglement Stimuleringsmaatregel Filmproductie in Nederland, Staatscourant 2026, 24849 (15 July 2026; minister's approval 23 June 2026)

figures.applies: Netherlands; production companies applying to the Netherlands Film Fund; regulation published 15 July 2026; 2024 figures from Film Facts & Figures 2025.

figures.finding: The Netherlands Film Fund's selective production support went to 33 of 62 majority feature applications in 2024 (EUR 23.3 million) and 239 of 638 selective production applications across all forms; the 36 Fund-supported majority Dutch features released in 2024 cost on average EUR 2.27 million, 42% of it from the Fund; total state aid to a film is capped at 50% of costs (60% for multi-country co-productions).
figures.applies: Netherlands; Netherlands Film Fund decisions in 2024 and majority Dutch features released in 2024 (Film Facts & Figures 2025); state-aid ceiling from the Fund's Algemeen Reglement of 1 January 2025.

sources.said: Production support majority (co-)productions 62 33 53% 23,344,815 29.1% … Selective production 638 239 37% 45,746,075 43.2% … In 2024, 883 out of 1549 applications for financial support were approved for funding. … Total 36 majority (co)productions 81,825 18,618 807 15,130 34,555 42% … Average 2,273 960

figures.finding: In a budget the Netherlands Film Fund supports, the producer's fee may be at most 7.5% and overhead at most 7.5% capped at EUR 350,000 a film; a Dutch minority co-producer may take 15% (features) or 17.5% (documentaries) for both together, and majority films under EUR 750,000 may take up to 17.5% combined.
figures.applies: Netherlands; budgets of productions supported by the Netherlands Film Fund (Financieel & Productioneel Protocol, 1 July 2026).

sources.said: De begrotingspost producers fee bedraagt maximaal 7,5%. De begrotingspost overhead bedraagt maximaal 7,5% gemaximeerd tot 350.000 euro per filmproductie.

figures.finding: 56 majority Dutch features and 15 minority co-productions opened in Dutch cinemas in 2024; Fund-supported majority features averaged 72,187 admissions.

sources.said: A total of 56 Dutch feature films and 15 minority co-production features were released in cinemas in 2024. On average, Fund-supported majority Dutch feature films in 2024 reached an audience of 72.187.

figures.finding: Dutch independent producers are organised in NAPA (Netherlands Audiovisual Producers Alliance), with about 85 member companies; to join, a company must have been registered with the Chamber of Commerce for at least two years, average at least €75,000 net turnover a year and have produced at least two productions outside education, and accept NAPA's code of conduct; dues are given on request.

value.name: Nederlandse Audiovisuele Producenten Alliantie (NAPA)
value.dues: not published (on request from the association secretary)

figures.applies: Netherlands, independent audiovisual producers (film, drama series, documentary, animation, games), as published 2026-11-01.

sources.said: The approx. 85 members are active in various disciplines, including feature film, drama series, documentary, animation, interactive productions and games.

Wil je weten of het NAPA-lidmaatschap bij jouw onderneming past, of meer weten over de voorwaarden en contributie? … Producenten die lid willen worden, moeten onder meer minimaal twee jaar bij de Kamer van Koophandel zijn ingeschreven, een gemiddelde netto-jaaromzet van ten minste € 75.000 hebben en minimaal twee producties buiten een opleiding of zelfeducatie hebben geproduceerd. … Ook onderschrijven leden de Gedragscode van NAPA.
